severity_criteria.source_excerpt: 14.1 Plaque Psoriasis: "14 CLINICAL STUDIES 14.1 Plaque Psoriasis Three multicenter, randomized, double-blind trials [Trial Ps-1 (NCT03370133), Trial Ps-2 (NCT03410992), and Trial Ps-3 (NCT03412747)] enrolled a total of 1,480 subjects 18 years of age and older with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who had a body surface area (BSA) involvement of ≥10%, an Investigator's Global Assessment (IGA) score of ≥3 (" ") in the overall assessment of psoriasis on a severity scale of 0 to 4, and a Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) score ≥12." -- Trial Ps-2 is explicitly identified as NCT03410992 in this label section; the common eligibility thresholds apply to the three named trials.

permitted_concomitant: Topical moisturizers or emollients, bath oils, or oatmeal bath preparations for skin conditions as needed
Mild and low potency topical steroids as needed, limited to the face, axilla, and/or genitalia

"treatment of PSO of the scalp are also permitted." "Mild and low potency topical steroids will be permitted for use limited to the face, axilla, and/or tio" "genitalia, as needed." "Subjects who are already receiving an established NSAID regimen for PsA or symptoms of ns i" "continue their use during the study." "Subjects may take mild pain relievers (acetaminophen/paracetamol, mild opiates) as needed for" "arthritis pain but preferably not within 24 hours of the Baseline and Week 56 Visits." "Intra-articular steroid injections of any joint and hyaluronic acid injections are allowed after" "Week 12." "Subjects who are receiving an established regimen for depression should remain on stable dosing" "prior to Baseline and throughout the study." -- These are permitted co-medications. multiplicity_control.source_excerpt: 4.5 Multiple comparisons/multiplicity: "4.5 Multiple comparisons/multiplicity" "The statistical analysis of the co-primary efficacy variables and selected secondary efficacy" "variables will account for multiplicity and control the familywise Type I error rate at a 2-sided f." "alpha level of 0.05 by using a fixed sequence testing procedure." "The first 2 hypotheses (H1 and H2) test whether bimekizumab is superior to placebo for PASI90 ria" "response and IGA response at Week 16." "If both are rejected at a 2-sided alpha level of 0.05, that alpha will be passed" "to the next test in the sequence, allowing the testing procedure to proceed." "The hypotheses associated with the subsequent tests are for secondary efficacy endpoints and are" "based on testing for superiority relative to placebo." "sequential testing sequence in Figure 4-1 and the formal evaluation of statistical significance of" "the 2-sided alpha level of 0.05." "each comparison is dependent upon the previous comparison achieving statistical significance at" -- The SAP states two-sided alpha 0.05, familywise control, and a fixed-sequence procedure. Its secondary sequence is shown in Figure 4-1, whose labels are not available as text candidates; no sequence rows are fabricated. SAP presence does not explicitly establish finalized status. SAP:2895 explicitly says multiplicity is controlled for the familywise Type I error rate; SAP:2909-2913 describes the conditional pass-through from both co-primary tests to secondary testing.

value.source_inconsistency: The protocol states a maximum total duration of 77 weeks, but also says relapse escape treatment may extend beyond the Week 56 visit and schedules safety follow-up 20 weeks after the final dose; it does not establish one fixed end week for those subjects.

study_schedule.source_excerpt: 5.2.3 Randomized-Withdrawal Period; 5.2.5 Escape Treatment; 5.3 Study duration per subject; 5.6 Schedule of study assessments: "For each subject, the study will last a maximum of" "77 weeks and will consist of 4 periods: a Screening Period (2 to 5 weeks), a double-blind," "placebo-controlled Initial Treatment Period (16 weeks), a double-blind, placebo-controlled" "Randomized-Withdrawal Period (40 weeks) Period, and a Safety Follow-Up (SFU) Period (20" "weeks after the final dose of investigational medicinal product [IMP])." "Eligible subjects will be randomized 4:1 to receive the following blinded IMP regimens:" " Bimekizumab 320mg administered sc every 4 weeks (Q4W)" " Placebo administered sc Q4W th D" "Investigational medicinal product will be administered in the clinic at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8," "and Week 12." "At the Week 16 study visit, bimekizumab and placebo subjects who have achieved" "a PASI90 response will enter the 40-week Randomized-Withdrawal Period." " Subjects initially randomized to bimekizumab 320mg Q4W will be re-randomized 1:1:1 to" "either bimekizumab 320mg Q4W or bimekizumab 320mg every 8 weeks (Q8W) or placebo" " Subjects initially randomized to placebo will continue to receive placebo (Q4W) provided the" "subject is a PASI90 responder" "Subjects who do not achieve a PASI90 response at Week 16 of the Initial Treatment Period will" "be allocated to an escape arm and receive open-label bimekizumab 320mg Q4W for 12 weeks." "All subjects who relapse at Week 20 or later during the Randomized-Withdrawal Period (up to" "um Week 56) will be allocated to an escape arm and receive open-label bimekizumab 320mg Q4W" "do for 12 weeks." "Relapse is defined as not achieving a PASI75 response." "Clinical Study Protocol Bimekizumab PS0013" "At Week 56, all subjects enrolling in the open-label study will undergo the Week 56 study re o" "enrolling in the open-label study will have their Week 56 study assessments and enter the SFU ns" "Period." "5.3 Study duration per subject ns i" "For each subject, the study will last a maximum of up to 77 weeks, as follows: ex" " Screening Period: 2 to 5 weeks an" " Double-blind, placebo-controlled Initial Treatment Period: 16 weeksan" " Double-blind, placebo-controlled Randomized-Withdrawal Period: 40 weeks" " Escape treatment (if required): 12 weeks at" "Safety Follow-Up Period: a SFU Visit is planned 20 weeks after the final dose of IMP (for" "subjects not enrolling in the open-label study)" "For subjects who relapse during the Randomized-Withdrawal Period, the subject should" "complete the 12-week escape treatment period even if this extends to a time point beyond what" "would have been the Week 56 visit (if the subject had not escaped)." "The Schedule of Study Assessments for all subjects enrolled in the study is presented in" "Table 5‒1." "Table 5‒1: Schedule of study assessments ria t" "Week Initial Treatment Period Randomized-Withdrawal Period s PEO SFU" "1 2 4 8 12 16 20 24 28 32" "an 36 40 44 48 52" -- The 77 weeks are the protocol's stated maximum total participation duration, not an end week measured from first dose. The protocol describes 2 to 5 weeks of screening, 16-week initial treatment, 40-week randomized-withdrawal, conditional 12-week escape treatment, and safety follow-up 20 weeks after final dose. Escape is not assigned an enum period name because the schema has no escape/open-label period. The selected protocol contains the full Schedule of Study Assessments tables. Week 16 is the co-primary assessment and re-randomization point. Keep fixed end_of_study_week null because relapse escape may continue beyond Week 56 and follow-up is anchored to final dose.

value.applies_to_period: initial treatment and randomized-withdrawal; escape treatment
value.rationale: The protocol calls this escape treatment: participants without PASI90 at Week 16 and participants relapsing at Week 20 or later during randomized-withdrawal receive open-label bimekizumab 320 mg Q4W for 12 weeks. Relapse is defined as not achieving PASI75. Participants achieving PASI50 by the end of 12 weeks of escape treatment are eligible to enroll in the open-label study.

rescue_therapy.source_excerpt: 5.2.5 Escape Treatment: "5.2.5 Escape Treatment" "As described above, subjects who do not achieve a PASI90 response at Week 16 of the Initial" "um Treatment Period and all subjects who relapse at Week 20 or later during the Randomized-" "do c Withdrawal Period (up to Week 56) will receive open-label bimekizumab 320mg Q4W for" "is 12 weeks (ie, escape treatment)." "For subjects who relapse during the Randomized-Withdrawal Period, the subject should" "complete the 12-week escape treatment period even if this extends to a time point beyond what" "would have been the Week 56 visit (if the subject had not escaped)." "Subjects who achieve a PASI50 response by the end of the 12 weeks of escape treatment are re o" "eligible to enroll in the open-label study." "Clinical Study Protocol Bimekizumab PS0013" -- Response-triggered escape treatment is described in protocol PS0013; for relapsing participants the 12-week escape period may extend beyond Week 56. The PASI50 criterion explicitly allows enrollment in the subsequent open-label study. No topical rescue rule or other rescue consequences are asserted.

published_results.source_excerpt: 14.1 Plaque Psoriasis; Table 3 clinical response at Week 16: "14 CLINICAL STUDIES 14.1 Plaque Psoriasis Three multicenter, randomized, double-blind trials [Trial Ps-1 (NCT03370133), Trial Ps-2 (NCT03410992), and Trial Ps-3 (NCT03412747)] enrolled a total of 1,480 subjects 18 years of age and older with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis who had a body surface area (BSA) involvement of ≥10%, an Investigator's Global Assessment (IGA) score of ≥3 (" "In Trial Ps-2, 435 subjects were randomized to either BIMZELX 320 mg by subcutaneous injection every 4 weeks or placebo." "Clinical Response at Week 16 (Trial Ps-1 and Trial Ps-2) Trial Ps-1 and Trial Ps-2 responses at Week 16 compared to placebo for the two co-primary endpoints: The proportion of subjects who achieved an IGA score of 0 (" "Table 3: Efficacy Results at Week 16 in BIMZELX or Placebo-Treated Adults with Plaque Psoriasis in Trial Ps-1 and Trial Ps-2 Trial Ps-1 Trial Ps-2 BIMZELX 320 mg every 4 weeks (N=321) n (%) Placebo (N=83) n (%) BIMZELX 320 mg every 4 weeks (N=349) n (%) Placebo (N=86) n (%) IGA 0 or 1 (" ") Co-primary endpoints 270 (84%) 4 (5%) 323 (93%) 1 (1%) Difference (95% CI) 79% (73%, 85%) 91% (88%, 95%) PASI 90 273 (85%) 4 (5%) 317 (91%) 1 (1%) Difference (95% CI) 80% (74%, 86%) 90% (86%, 93%) IGA 0 (" -- Trial Ps-2 is NCT03410992. Table 3 reports the Week 16 co-primary results for the two Trial Ps-2 arms; arm IDs are joined to matching base registry arms by treatment and denominators. The label prints responder counts and percentages together as n (%), so rate_is_derived is false. The IGA row corresponds to the second primary endpoint in the registry outcome order; the table presents both co-primary results.
